lines: Aur phir behisaab peeta hai.
couplets.en: And then he drinks without measure.

lines: Jaanta hai ke cheez hai yeh buri.
Phir bhi khana kharab peeta hai.
couplets.en: He knows the harm, yet the poor wretch drinks.

lines: Aur phir behisaab peeta hai.
Jaanta hai ke cheez hai yeh buri.
couplets.en: He drinks without measure, knowing all the while what harm it does.

lines: Phir bhi khana kharab peeta hai.
Kyun sharabi sharab peeta hai?
couplets.en: Why does the poor wretch go on drinking?

lines: Is qadar gham mile hain duniya se.
Hum na peete to mar gaye hote.
couplets.en: The world has given me such grief that without drink I would have died.

lines: Is qadar gham mile hain duniya se.
Hum na peete to mar gaye hote.
couplets.en: The world has given me such grief that without drink I would have died.

lines: Gar sahara na jaam ka hota.
Jaane kab ke bikhar gaye hote.
couplets.en: Without the cup to lean on, I would have fallen apart long ago.

lines: Jis ne aansoo piye hain chup chup ke.
Aaj woh behisaab peeta hai.
couplets.en: He who swallowed his tears in secret now drinks without measure.

lines: Kyun sharabi sharab peeta hai, aur phir behisaab peeta hai?
Jaanta hai ke cheez hai yeh buri, phir bhi khana kharab peeta hai.
couplets.en: Why does the poor wretch drink without measure when he knows the harm?

lines: Kyun sharabi, kyun sharabi, kyun sharabi, kyun sharabi, kyun?
Aankh mein khushk ho gaye aansoo.
Ek qatra lahu ka dil mein hai.
couplets.en: The tears have dried in my eyes, and a single drop of blood remains in my heart.

lines: Kaun sa jurm hai, jo mere liye.
Is qadar tang ho gayi hai zameen?
couplets.en: What crime have I committed that the earth has narrowed so around me?

lines: Kuchh to dukh hai jise chhupane ko.
Yeh itni sharab peeta hai.
couplets.en: There must be some sorrow he drinks so much to hide.

lines: Kyun sharabi sharab peeta hai?
Aur phir behisaab peeta hai.
couplets.en: Why does the drinker drink, and why without measure?

lines: Jaanta hai ke cheez hai yeh buri.
Phir bhi khana kharab peeta hai.
couplets.en: He knows the harm, yet the poor wretch drinks.

lines: Kyun sharabi sharab peeta hai?
